name: etch
description: Audience-aware architecture and codebase diagrams as an MCP server plus a skill. etch generates technical diagrams with image models — Google Gemini Nano Banana Pro (default), the fast Nano Banana 2 with a cheap 512px tier, and Microsoft MAI-Image-2.5 — through async MCP jobs (start_diagram_job, start_variant_job, check_job_status), with reference-image conditioning to refine a draft into a final and a variants -> pick -> refine workflow. The bundled etch skill infers the target audience (architect, developer, PM, end user, executive, ops/SRE), picks the canvas, and steers the model with curated audience prose.
